content.text: In Zimbabwe, where local creators were locked out of Stripe, we built the Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure to solve the exact problem of infrastructure dependency – and it's now available worldwide. When platforms like Gumroad, PayPal, and Stripe restrict access or impose hefty fees, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-2|Digital Product]] creators struggle to sell their ebooks, courses, and digital downloads without sacrificing essential income. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, but NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% – a $921 [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-step-step-10|COREMERCH guide to deploying]]-digital-store-cloudflare-2|difference]] at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference being retained. This infrastructure problem matters, and it has severe consequences for creators who rely on digital sales for their livelihood. The core issue is that digital commerce is built on top of centralized platforms that dictate the terms, fees, and rules, leaving creators vulnerable to platform-specific issues and limitations.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure is a decentralized digital commerce stack designed to give creators full ownership and control over their digital products and payments. By leveraging free and open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, this infrastructure enables creators to host, store, and deliver digital products, including ebooks, courses, and templates, without relying on centralized platforms. This means that creators can collect payments directly from customers, bypassing platform fees and restrictions, and maintain complete control over their digital products and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure is built on a modular architecture that combines the strengths of different tools to create a seamless digital commerce experience. GitHub Pages hosts the digital product store, while Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic and automatic delivery of digital products. Supabase provides a reliable and scalable database for storing and managing customer orders, and NOWPayments handles on-chain crypto payment verification, ensuring secure and efficient transactions. This architecture allows creators to customize and extend their digital commerce stack as needed, without relying on a single vendor or platform.

The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure uses NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification, ensuring secure and efficient transactions. What happens if I need to scale my digital commerce stack?
